rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic revenue management software that uses competitors' nonpublic leasing data to set or recommend rents; software providers/coordinators may not use it to coordinate pricing among competing landlords. Attorney General runs a complaint portal.
rules.key_value: ban on rent-setting software using competitors' nonpublic leasing data
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property owners, property managers, software providers and other coordinators
rules.exemptions: Spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, government-administered affordable housing programs
rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act takes effect on July 1, 2027
rules.interaction: Page does not state whether it preempts local ordinances; possible conflict with local bans (Jersey City, Hoboken) needs review.

notes: Law-firm summary; signed July 20 (2026), effective 2027-07-01. Preemption of local ordinances is NOT addressed in this page.
